summary: The registrant, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K to disclose that it received a letter from Nasdaq confirming it has regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had been given a compliance period until August 3, 2026; on April 28, 2026, Nasdaq determined that from April 13 to April 27, 2026, the closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for 11 consecutive business days, closing the matter. No special-situation event is involved; this is a routine regulatory compliance update. There are no deal terms, as the filing does not relate to a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or capital event.
